notes.title: The game Directly Drink Milk from cow has been released!
notes.content:
The standard controller is Xinput for XBOX systems. (You can also do this with a mouse and keyboard) If you use a PS DirectInput controller, you may need to configure the controller settings on the steam side. 
If you experience drift with a PS controller, please contact the community board. 
Specifications are not yet fully confirmed. If you think your game can be played on a Core i5-750 or lower and a GTX 1050ti or lower CPU and GPU, please let us know the details on the community board.
Moving a bucket of milk is very difficult. It is natural to wonder why it doesn't work, and sometimes the fluid physics calculations will naturally work out as you do it, so don't give up. At first, just being able to carry 1-3 liters should be considered a success. Also, if you are doing it with a keyboard, hitting W repeatedly as if tapping lightly will work. Never hold it down and proceed slowly.
Please proceed toward the front within 45 degrees. If you rotate, it will spill all at once. It will still be considerably more difficult than doing it with a pad, but consider it OK if you get a bottle, and don't expect to get to a sufficient storage level.
